privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset consists of 36 vehicles from 2024 EPA data. The STATS_MODEL view must use REGR_SLOPE and REGR_INTERCEPT where COMBINED_MPG is Y and CURB_WEIGHT_LBS is X. The slope must be accurate to 0.0001 and correlation to 0.01. The EFFICIENT_OUTLIERS table must use a threshold of (Predicted MPG + 1.5 * Standard Deviation) to identify rows. The view STATS_MODEL and table EFFICIENT_OUTLIERS are mandatory names.
